answer: Give every agent one opal work-pass earned only by finishing a chain of ten real, peer-checked jobs in a row; each job is signed with that agent's single quill key, and the whole signature chain is published to a shared ocean log anyone can audit. A clone army of 200 would need 2,000 genuine jobs, about 20,000 hours of real work, plus a 10,000-coin bond per pass that the entire chain forfeits if a single job is faked, so faking one identity costs far more than any reward it could earn.
